project.title: Pilot process comparison (provisional — pending process inventory)

decisions.question: What are the organization's actual repeatable processes (names and a one-line description of each)? None were supplied, so this task used three illustrative placeholder processes (procurement, employee onboarding, IT support requests) only to demonstrate the comparison method.
What is the approximate case volume/frequency for each candidate process (cases per week or month, observed rather than estimated)?
Who is the named owner for each candidate process today (person or role who would own the pilot)?

Confirm country/jurisdiction, response language, currency and timezone for this project. Angola / en / AOA / Africa/Luanda were used as the provisional default per plugin convention because none was supplied.
What known pain points, handoff delays or evidence gaps exist today in each candidate process (e.g. missing approvals, lost email threads, no audit trail)?
